verified_facts.text: The hotel sits in the harbourside village of Double Bay, a short distance from Sydney's CBD.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tucked within the harbourside village of Double Bay, our hotel offers a peaceful retreat just a short distance from the CBD.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is on Double Bay's main shopping strip.
verified_facts.excerpt: InterContinental Sydney Double Bay occupies prime real estate on Double Bay’s main shopping strip.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's white facade has balconies and arched windows overlooking leafy trees.
verified_facts.excerpt: Its large but fairly low-key white façade suits the "urban village" vibe of this upscale Eastern Suburbs neighbourhood, with balconies and arched windows overlooking leafy trees.

verified_facts.text: Some rooms look out over the bay, some over the neighbourhood, and others onto a French-style courtyard.
verified_facts.excerpt: The bay glimmers through some windows, its mood changing with the light. Some look down over the neighbourhood, while others open onto a tucked-away French-style courtyard.

verified_facts.text: Many rooms have private balconies or courtyards.
verified_facts.excerpt: Private balconies and courtyards up the indulgence in many rooms.

verified_facts.text: Some rooms look over Sydney Harbour and Double Bay's marina.
verified_facts.excerpt: Let your gaze linger over Sydney Harbour and the gentle shimmer of Double Bay’s marina.

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms are in polished Italian marble with double basins and a separate bath and shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Polished Italian marble bathrooms offer double basins and a separate bath and shower, ideal for couples.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has one outdoor pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: InterContinental Sydney Double Bay has 1 outdoor pool.

verified_facts.text: The outdoor pool has great views of Sydney Harbour.
verified_facts.excerpt: Great views of Sydney Harbour

verified_facts.text: The Upper Bar is framed by sweeping harbour views.

verified_facts.text: The Bar draws inspiration from the great hotel bars of London, Rome, Paris and New York.
verified_facts.excerpt: Drawing inspiration from the great hotel bars of London, Rome, Paris, and New York, this space is a tribute to timeless sophistication and glamour.

verified_facts.text: The Upper Bar serves high tea by day.
verified_facts.excerpt: At The Upper Bar, casual plates meet the sky. By day, the bar invites you to savour the delicate layers of high tea

verified_facts.text: Bayside Bistro and Bar pours beers on tap, cocktails and wines.
verified_facts.excerpt: Behind the bar, discover a curated selection of beers on tap, cocktails, and well chosen wines.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is proudly pet friendly.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are a proudly pet friendly hotel.
